message.content: The result shows the AfriTrade Agent interface, a voice - powered trade intelligence assistant for ECOWAS cross - border commerce. A currency conversion card is not currently showing on the screen. The exchange rate details are not displayed in the current view; however, there is a “Currency” feature (labeled “Live Exchange Rates”) available as one of the tools (along with “Tariff Lookup” and “Route Finder”) that users can access to get exchange rate information.
